extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication; no direct molecular target is overclaimed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Plantaricin ZJ5 is source-supported as a mature 22 aa, linear class II/IId bacteriocin produced from a 44 aa double-glycine leader precursor.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Classification and precursor processing context are not direct target/mechanism assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Protease sensitivity supports a proteinaceous bacteriocin identity: pepsin abolishes activity and proteinase K reduces the inhibition zone, while lipase and alpha-amylase do not affect activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Enzyme sensitivity supports peptide/proteinaceous identity but does not identify a cellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Table 1 and Table S1 support broad antibacterial activity plus pH 2-6 stability, with no activity against the two tested yeast strains.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Spectrum and pH stability are activity/stability observations, not direct mechanism claims.
